```sql
WITH barree_township AS (
  SELECT region_name, geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Barree Township'
    AND border_type = 'township'
    AND addr_state = 'PA'
),
mean_elevation AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(rast, 1, barree.geometry::geometry, TRUE)).sum / ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(rast, 1, barree.geometry::geometry, TRUE)).count) AS mean_elev
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    barree_township barree
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, barree.geometry::geometry)
),
nature_reserve_above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    poi.poi_name,
    poi.addr_city,
    poi.addr_state
  FROM
    pois poi,
    barree_township barree,
    mean_elevation mean
  WHERE
    poi.poi_name = 'Shavers Creek Environmental Center'
    AND ST_Contains(barree.geometry::geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.909905 40.667715)', 4326)::geography::geometry)
    AND ST_Distance(poi.geometry::geometry, barree.geometry::geometry) > 0
    AND ST_Distance(poi.geometry::geometry, barree.geometry::geometry) < 100000
    AND (ST_Value(public.dem_us.rast, 1, poi.geometry::geometry) > mean.mean_elev)
    AND ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, poi.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT * FROM nature_reserve_above_mean;
```
